description: Connect Claude Code sessions to the local coflux daemon (every hook is a silent no-op when coflux or node is not installed); hooks carry no turn state, which comes from the agent's own OSC 7501 reports. At session start, inside a coflux terminal, print the <coflux-session> block with the session's coflux coordinates, and send the agent's session id through the `coflux hook claude` messenger so the desktop can open its transcript; on every prompt, print a <coflux-session-moved> block when the working directory sits in a different coflux workspace than the terminal does; follow the agent into git worktrees (EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, resume and Claude Code's own cleanup move the terminal's owning workspace, registering an unknown worktree first); on PreToolUse, the same messenger denies `git worktree remove|move` only when its target is a worktree coflux has registered as a workspace on this device, pointing the agent to `coflux workspace remove <workspaceId>`, and otherwise stays silent.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v coflux >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec coflux hook claude || :'
